title: Window Scan

story.briefing: The district meters its power in fixed intervals. Find the busiest interval of exactly the length the meter is calibrated for.
story.success: Peak interval identified. The meter recalibrates and stops tripping.

description: Given an array of readings and a window size k, return the largest sum obtainable from k consecutive readings. If k is less than 1, or larger than the number of readings, return -1.
hints: Neighbouring windows overlap almost entirely. Recomputing the whole sum for each one throws away work you already did.
Moving the window one step right adds exactly one reading and removes exactly one. That is two operations per step, not k.
Sum the first k readings. Then for each following position, add the entering reading and subtract the leaving one, tracking the maximum you have seen.
